title: NAMEOF with PARENT, MINIMALLYESCAPED gives a simple table name without quotes

source.quote: Names that contain only simple letters, digits, and underscores are returned without delimiters
source.supports: example 5 of the page: NAMEOF ( 'Sales'[Sales Amount], PARENT, MINIMALLYESCAPED ) returns Sales

derivation: Example 5 uses Sales[Sales Amount]; here Sales[Amount]. The parent of a column is its table; Sales has only letters, so no quotes.
